Exactly SIXdistinct fullbody chronologicalposes equal3columns x2rows on1536x1024, each512cell. Fullsubject MAXIMUM320px wide/tall including wings antennae legs in EVERYcell, centered with90pxsafe margin; no overlap. EN-009 DIVE attack, no victim or contact effects. Head points clearlyDOWNRIGHT in phases3and4. Braking wings openphase5, pullup6. Not6horizontalhover poses.
